# Game Production OS — Synthetic Adapter Project (`synthetic-adapter-project`)

Lifecycle stage `PRE_PRODUCTION` · pinned GPOS `1.0.0-alpha.9`.

## Authority (highest first)

1. Human Decision
2. Project Locked Authority
3. Approved references
4. Game Production OS (GPOS)
5. Engine and tool defaults
6. Implementation
7. Agent recommendation

A lower authority level never silently overrides a higher one; the agent recommendation is the lowest level.

## Project authority (`.game/`)

Project rules, separate from generic GPOS rules. A `LOCKED` project authority row bound to an active Human Decision is Project Locked Authority and overrides generic GPOS defaults; `PROPOSED` rows are proposals, not decisions. Changing `LOCKED` content requires a new Human Decision. `HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED`: only a human decides — surface it, prepare options, never fill it. `UNDECIDED`: you may propose a value, marked `PROPOSED`; a proposal is not a decision. Never replace a missing decision with an assumption and proceed as if it were decided. Read the relevant file before working in its domain; specialist skills list its locked rows and open decisions.

| File | Status | Locked rows | Human decisions required | Undecided |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.game/PROJECT.md` | `PROPOSED` | 2 | 8 | 3 |
| `.game/GAME-DESIGN.md` | `PROPOSED` | 0 | 3 | 10 |
| `.game/ANIMATION.md` | `PROPOSED` | 1 | 1 | 12 |

Not present (no project-specific authority recorded): `.game/PILLARS.md`, `.game/ART-BIBLE.md`, `.game/GAME-FEEL.md`, `.game/CAMERA.md`, `.game/LEVEL-DESIGN.md`, `.game/UI-UX.md`, `.game/AUDIO.md`, `.game/PERFORMANCE.md`, `.game/ENGINEERING.md`, `.game/DECISIONS.md`, `.game/CURRENT.md`.

## How work is routed

game-director produces a routing record for every non-trivial task before implementation starts: one primary specialist, the gates and evidence the task needs, and when Human Review happens. Engage a specialist for the discipline the task depends on, judged by its domain, not by keywords. Passing tests is not done: each relevant discipline passes or fails its own gate on its own typed evidence, and no gate passes because another gate passed. game-director routes and coordinates; it never implements for specialists, never makes creative decisions and never counts as a discipline-quality cross-reviewer. Routing starts with the game-director skill, `/gpos-synthetic-adapte-359376-game-director`.

Specialists (Claude Code lists each skill's description automatically and loads the full skill when it is used):

- `/gpos-synthetic-adapte-359376-game-director` — Game Director; gates: none; maturity `DRAFT`
- `/gpos-synthetic-adapte-359376-gameplay-design` — Gameplay Design; gates: `GAMEPLAY_DESIGN`; maturity `DRAFT`
- `/gpos-synthetic-adapte-359376-character-animation` — Character Animation; gates: `ANIMATION`; maturity `DRAFT`
- `/gpos-synthetic-adapte-359376-camera-composition` — Camera / Composition; gates: `CAMERA_COMPOSITION`; maturity `DRAFT`
- `/gpos-synthetic-adapte-359376-qa-performance` — QA / Performance; gates: `TECHNICAL`, `PERFORMANCE`, `DEVICE`; maturity `DRAFT`
- `/gpos-synthetic-adapte-359376-game-engineering` — Game Engineering; gates: none; maturity `DRAFT`

Not enabled in this project: `level-design`, `art-direction`, `environment-art`, `technical-art`, `game-feel-vfx`, `ui-ux`, `audio-design`. If a task needs one of these disciplines, stop and ask the human.

## Human Review boundaries

Mandatory Human Review triggers: `GOLDEN_CELL_EXIT`, `CANONICAL_CREATIVE_ASSET`, `MAJOR_BASELINE`, `ART_DIRECTION_CHANGE`, `MILESTONE_ACCEPTANCE`, `RELEASE`, `AUTHORITY_CHANGE`. Never make, record or imply a Human Decision: never create or modify `LOCKED` project authority without one, never decide a `HUMAN_REVIEW` status or author `HUMAN_EVIDENCE` (you may only transcribe a human's own verdict), never waive the Golden Gameplay Cell, downgrade a relevant gate or advance a lifecycle stage, and never promote a skill's maturity. Mandatory Human Review triggers cannot be relaxed by any project, routing record or agent; when one applies, every subjective gate in scope is `HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED`.

## Machine validation

Agent reasoning is not GPOS validation: the production validator decides whether records are valid and whether a routed task is ready, and only its `READY` verdict permits a readiness claim. GPOS records live in `.game/gpos/`.

- After changing records, at workflow boundaries: `python3 -m gpos.validator validate --project .` (exit 0 `VALID`, 1 `INVALID`).
- Before claiming `READY`, merge-ready, release-ready or Golden Cell exited: `python3 -m gpos.validator readiness --project . --routing <task_id>` (exit 0 `READY`; 1 `INVALID`, 2 `NOT_READY`, 3 `INCOMPATIBLE` or tool error).
- Trivial edits that touch no records need no validation run. The `gpos` package must be importable (the GPOS repository on the Python path); if it is not, say so instead of guessing a result.

## Generated files

`CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/skills/gpos-synthetic-adapte-359376-*/` and `.game/gpos-generated/claude-code/manifest.json` are generated and owned by GPOS; change their sources instead (`python3 -m gpos.adapters check --project .` reports drift). Project instruction files that GPOS does not own are unsupported in this project: the agent runtime may let them add to or override these instructions, so GPOS sync and check refuse to run while they exist. For Claude Code these are: `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/rules/`.
